name: Abnormal Security
summary: Cloud email-security platform using behavioral AI to detect targeted attacks.
overview: Abnormal Security protects organizations from sophisticated email-based threats.
bull_case: Email remains a critical attack surface, and behavioral detection can improve with data scale.
bear_case: Crowded security budgets and incumbent suites can constrain standalone expansion.

intelligence.description: Abnormal AI uses behavioral models to detect phishing, social-engineering and other human-targeted attacks across cloud email and collaboration environments.
company: Abnormal's platform models normal communication patterns to flag impersonation, business-email compromise and related attacks that evade rule-based filters.
It sells primarily to enterprises and has expanded its positioning from email security toward broader human-behavior security.
intelligence.why_it_matters: Abnormal is a leading example of AI-native security software with clear enterprise budgets. Its performance is relevant to private cybersecurity peers using models to automate high-value analyst work.

changed.text: Raised $250M in Series D financing at a $5.1B valuation.
Reported continued product expansion around AI-native human-behavior security.

takeaways: Social engineering is an expanding attack surface for enterprise customers.
Behavioral detection is differentiated only if it produces measurably better outcomes.
The $5.1B mark is the latest publicly disclosed valuation.
